about.title: Who is Durr Electric?
text: If you need a reliable Alvin, TX, electrician to handle an important project, look no further than Durr Electric. As a locally owned and operated business, we are committed to providing some of the best services at the most affordable prices. We are also focused on completing every project promptly and professionally.

When you call Durr Electric for service, you get a state-licensed Alvin, TX, electrician with references available throughout the community. Our free estimates and 24/7 emergency services help us keep a loyal customer base, and we are proud of our A+ rating with the Better Business Bureau.
Our staff is available seven days a week, and we accept cash, credit and debit cards and personal checks. Call today to schedule an appointment.

faqs.q: Do you charge for an estimate?
faqs.a: No. Estimates are free. Call the office and we will schedule an appointment.

faqs.a: Yes. We provide 24 hour day and night emergency service, and our staff is available seven days a week.
We accept cash, credit and debit cards, and personal checks.

faqs.q: Do you work on commercial buildings as well as houses?
